item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 14 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 14 #VISPRSD
Issued at 07:10 PM 20 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(Daanbantayan, Medellin), #Bohol(Catigbian, Tubigon, SierraBullones, GarciaHernandez, Jagna, Bilar, Valencia, Mabini, Ubay, SanMiguel, Trinidad and Buenavista) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Cebu(SantaFe, Madridejos, Bantayan), #Bohol(Sagbayan, Danao, Dagohoy, Carmen, Inabanga, Clarin, Batuan, Guindulman, Anda, Alicia, Candijay, Pilar and Duero) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
